en.text:
I am a {{MERN Stack Developer}} with [[3+ years]] of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications and RESTful APIs. I hold a BSCS degree and specialize in JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL.

I focus on turning complex business requirements into clean, efficient, and user-focused digital solutions. My work involves designing reliable backend systems, improving application architecture, and enhancing user experiences through well-structured code and thoughtful UI integration.

I have contributed to real-world production systems by developing robust APIs, refining frontend functionality, and ensuring smooth communication between client and server-side components.

I enjoy solving challenging problems, optimizing application logic, and continuously improving performance and scalability through better engineering practices.

I thrive in Agile teams where collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous learning drive impactful results.

I’m always open to new opportunities—[[let’s connect!]]

es.text:
Soy un {{desarrollador MERN Stack}} con [[más de 3 años]] de experiencia creando aplicaciones web escalables y APIs RESTful de alto rendimiento. Tengo un título en BSCS y me especializo en JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB y MySQL.

Me enfoco en transformar requisitos complejos en soluciones digitales limpias, eficientes y centradas en el usuario. Mi trabajo incluye el diseño de sistemas backend confiables, la mejora de arquitecturas de aplicaciones y la optimización de la experiencia de usuario.

He contribuido a sistemas en producción desarrollando APIs robustas, mejorando funcionalidades frontend y asegurando una comunicación fluida entre el cliente y el servidor.

Disfruto resolver problemas desafiantes, optimizar la lógica de las aplicaciones y mejorar continuamente el rendimiento y la escalabilidad.

Me adapto bien a equipos Agile donde la colaboración y el aprendizaje continuo generan resultados de impacto.

Estoy abierto a nuevas oportunidades—[[¡conectemos!]]

fr.text:
Je suis {{développeur MERN Stack}} avec [[plus de 3 ans]] d’expérience dans la création d’applications web évolutives et d’API RESTful performantes. Titulaire d’un BSCS, je me spécialise en JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB et MySQL.

Je me concentre sur la transformation de besoins complexes en solutions digitales propres, efficaces et centrées sur l’utilisateur. Mon travail inclut la conception de systèmes backend fiables, l’amélioration de l’architecture des applications et l’optimisation de l’expérience utilisateur.

J’ai contribué à des systèmes en production en développant des API robustes, en améliorant les fonctionnalités frontend et en assurant une communication fluide entre client et serveur.

J’aime résoudre des problèmes complexes, optimiser la logique applicative et améliorer continuellement les performances et la scalabilité.

Je m’épanouis dans des équipes Agile où la collaboration et l’apprentissage continu créent de la valeur.

Je suis ouvert aux opportunités—[[connectons-nous !]]

ko.text:
저는 {{MERN 스택 개발자}}로서 [[3년 이상의]] 경험을 바탕으로 확장 가능하고 고성능의 웹 애플리케이션 및 RESTful API를 개발합니다. BSCS 학위를 보유하고 있으며 JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL을 전문으로 합니다.

복잡한 비즈니스 요구사항을 깔끔하고 효율적이며 사용자 중심의 디지털 솔루션으로 전환하는 데 집중합니다. 안정적인 백엔드 시스템 설계, 애플리케이션 구조 개선, UI와 서버 간의 원활한 연동을 담당합니다.

실제 프로덕션 환경에서 강력한 API 개발, 프론트엔드 기능 개선, 클라이언트-서버 간 안정적인 데이터 흐름을 구축한 경험이 있습니다.

복잡한 문제 해결, 애플리케이션 로직 최적화, 성능 및 확장성 개선을 지속적으로 추구합니다.

협업과 지속적인 학습이 중요한 Agile 환경에서 가장 잘 성장합니다.

새로운 기회를 환영합니다—[[함께 이야기해요!]]
